name: Open Nexus India Featuring: AGNTSummit + KubeCon + CloudNativeCon + Open Source Summit + PyTorch Conference
description: Open Nexus India connects the open source, cloud native, AI, and agentic AI communities, bringing together the people building everything from foundational software and cloud platforms to AI models and agents. Uniting AGNTSummit, KubeCon + CloudNativeCon, Open Source Summit and PyTorch Conference, , the event brings developers, maintainers, researchers, and technology leaders together to share practical expertise, collaborate across projects, and build and operate the next generation of open technology.
